basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 4-bed, 3-bath home offering 1,485 sqft of versatile living space. This home features elegant wood floors that set a warm and inviting tone throughout the property. The kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, ample storage with well-designed cabinets, and a garden window that bathes the space in natural light. The bedrooms are spacious and thoughtfully designed, each equipped with built-in cabinets for added convenience. One bedroom stands out with a built-in double decker bed, perfect for optimizing space and accommodating family or guests. The bathrooms feature showers over tubs equipped with glass doors. The backyard is designed for easy maintenance, allowing you to enjoy outdoor living without the hassle of extensive upkeep. The property is thoughtfully arranged with the ground floor currently tenant-occupied, while the second floor is available for your personal use or as a rental opportunity. Minutes away from grocery stores, restaurants, parks and with easy access to l-280. This home offers a blend of modern amenities and cozy charm, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a move-in-ready property with flexible living arrangements and a low-maintenance lifestyle.
